violations.description: Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not properly protected from potential contamination. Close bags/boxes of food items in walk in freezer.--Food item was not stored in a clean, dry location a minimum of 6 inches above the floor. Boxes of food items in walk in freezer placed on floor.

Preventing contamination by consumers. — --Food on display for self service was not properly protected by food guards, display cases, or similarly effective means. Cookies in hold unit for customer self service not protected with adequate sneeze protection.

General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of nonfood contact surface was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. Seal edge of particle board shelf at prep station in kitchen.
Toilet facilities. — --Public toilet rooms are not provided with a self closing door.
Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not properly protected from potential contamination. Close boxes/bags of food items in walk in cooler.

Preventing contamination by consumers. — --Food on display for self service was not properly protected by food guards, display cases, or similarly effective means. Unwrapped cookies at customer service counter display not provided with adequate sneeze protection.
Toilet facilities. — --Toilet room was not provided with a self closing door. Men's & women's restroom doors not provided with self closing devices.
Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. Multiple floors tiles missing or damaged.
